name: Logic App (Consumption)
summary: Consumption-tier Logic App workflow for orchestrating connectors, approvals and system integrations with a visual designer and pay-per-execution billing.
useWhen: You need to orchestrate calls across many SaaS/Azure connectors with minimal custom code
You need a human-approval step or a scheduled/event-driven business process
avoidWhen: You need complex custom logic, unit testing or source-control-friendly code (write a Function or Container App instead)
You need the Standard (App Service-hosted) tier for VNet integration and stateful workflows at scale (not covered by this module)
